items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: this black woman who is the news commentator -- her last name is Williams

ctx.x: So then -- I'm not finished yet --

so then, about nine months later, I'm looking at the TV in Los Angeles, and this black woman who is the news commentator -- her last name is Williams. Now, I had another young lady that I had the third daughter by -- her name was Tara, and her brother -- I didn't know it at the time, but her brother was the lead singer with the Platters, and I was making all their records and their albums and everything, recording them all the time -- but I didn't know that this was her brother; although, I remember that when I…

So, anyway, I saw one of the singers, because they all lived out there in California anyway; I saw one of the singers that used to be with the Platters, at a party. And we got to talking, and I told him the story, and he said, 'Well, do you look at Channel 7?' -- and I said, 'Yeah', and he said, 'Well, that newscaster -- that woman newscaster is Tony's ex-wife. She should know how to get in touch with his sister.'
